ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to FSHN undergraduate and graduate students only until after junior registration. Remaining seats will be released to the general student population when sophomore registration opens. If you get a 'course full' error message and want to be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Current Students then Waitlist Information. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in January.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign or Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
